inlines.v: ERA'SE, verb transitive [Latin erado, erasi; e and rado, to scrape; Heb. a graving tool.] 1. To rub or scrape out, as letters or characters written, engraved or painted; to efface; as, to erase a word or a name. 2. To obliterate; to expunge; to blot out; as with pen and ink. 3. To efface; to destroy; as ideas in the mind or memory. 4. To destroy to the foundation. [See Raze.]
